threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver shouts out stops as if it’s a personal challenge to your ability to find your way.
Caught the N159 last night; a guy in a full dinosaur suit playing peekaboo with the driver—pure Brixton charm at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy calmly reading Kafka on the U-Bahn while a street musician played an accordion in the corner. Total Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night bakery still open at 3 AM dishing out fresh bagels alongside pizza slices. Pure magic!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You’ll hear a true local mumble the bus schedule under their breath after seeing a delay, while newcomers just stare at their phones bewildered.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy trying to fix a broken Muni stop sign with duct tape while waiting for his bus. Only in the Tenderloin do we MacGyver our rides.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just for hipster cafés and markets, but they miss the quiet charm of its hidden squares, especially after dark.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their excitement over getting a brunch spot at 11am on a Sunday when locals know it's packed and often reserved.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a latte, not a flat white, and you're clutching that takeaway cup like it's gold. Everyone else is already on to terrace glasses.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the bus with old soul tunes. Half the passengers joined in, turning the ride into a makeshift karaoke session.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a bright orange vinyl in a secondhand shop while dodging U-Bahn delays – it felt like a hidden treasure just for us Neuköllners.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do buses and trams pause for spontaneous street festivals. You'll see the whole flex schedule shuffle when a party breaks out!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they can name the exact street where the burrito truck is parked without checking their phone.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a street performer on Muni who turned a whole commute into a sing-along. Even the bus driver joined in. Only in SF!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'pintxos' are everywhere here. In Gràcia, it's all about 'tapas' from the corner bodega; the real vibe is local, not trendy.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll often find them using Google Maps to navigate the simplest routes around Gràcia, missing all the shortcuts locals know.
